narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On May 22, 2024, at approximately 1100 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a hotel in Dearborn, Michigan, where he works as a housekeeper, during an inquiry about unauthorized employment. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Jordan and presented a Jordanian passport containing a B1/B2 visa.
ENTRY:
The subject was admitted at Chicago O'Hare International Airport on 03/14/2017 as a B2 visitor authorized to remain until 09/13/2017. He did not depart.
IMMIGRATION HISTORY:
Records confirm the admission and show no other immigration history.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is removable under Section 237(a)(1)(B) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that after admission as a nonimmigrant he remained in the United States for a time longer than permitted.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear.
